question: Should CodexBar adopt this permanent local usage-card export, and should its aggregation model be consolidated with the companion dashboard before either draft lands?
rationale: VISION.md reserves new product surfaces for explicit sign-off, while these drafts propose separate presentation features over substantially overlapping cross-subscription data.

options.title: Approve and consolidate
options.body: Adopt the local export while sharing one account-complete aggregation seam with the companion dashboard and requiring complete native runtime proof.

options.title: Approve export only
options.body: Keep this standalone card workflow but close or defer the companion dashboard to avoid maintaining two new surfaces simultaneously.

options.title: Decline the surface
options.body: Do not add a permanent sharing workflow if image-card export falls outside CodexBar’s focused menu-bar product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve and consolidate
recommendation.body: Adopt the local export while sharing one account-complete aggregation seam with the companion dashboard and requiring complete native runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner controls the VISION.md-gated product direction and is the best available owner for choosing the permanent surface.
